In keeping with the combinatory methodology of the Paṭṭhāna, the text investigates conditional relations by correlating the triad on wholesomeness (*kusalattika*) with the dyad pertaining to what can be cognized (*kenaciviññeyyaduka*) [SuttaCentral].
